projects.title: 企业资金管理系统 AI Agent
projects.titleEn: AI Agent for Enterprise Treasury Management
projects.subtitle: 从零搭建 Agent Harness 全栈架构 — Planning / Prompt / RAG / Memory / Skill / Multi-Agent 六层设计
projects.subtitleEn: Built Agent Harness from scratch — 6-layer architecture: Planning, Prompt, RAG, Memory, Skill, Multi-Agent
projects.objective: 为企业资金管理系统设计并实现内置 AI 智能助手模块。核心挑战不是"调用 LLM"，而是在企业内网约束下，从零搭建一个完整的 Agent Harness（脚手架层），让 LLM 具备感知真实数据、调用工具、跨会话记忆和个性化响应的能力。
projects.objectiveEn: Designed and implemented an AI assistant module for enterprise treasury management. The core challenge was not "calling LLM API" but building a complete Agent Harness from scratch under enterprise intranet constraints.
projects.methodology: 架构分六层实现：(1) Planning 层：双模式路由（Chat 模式直调 LLM Gateway vs Agent 模式 spawn Claude Code CLI 子进程执行 ReAct 循环）；(2) Prompt 层：角色分化的 System Prompt；(3) RAG 层：结构化财务数据全量注入，用户可控上下文选择；(4) Memory 层：L2 会话历史持久化（60条滑动窗口）；(5) Skill 层：预定义技能执行器，结果带 TTL 缓存；(6) Multi-Agent 层：Coordinator + 专家 Agent Swarm 架构设计。
projects.methodologyEn: Architecture in 6 layers: (1) Planning: Dual-mode routing (Chat → LLM Gateway vs Agent → Claude Code CLI subprocess with ReAct loop); (2) Prompt: Role-differentiated System Prompts; (3) RAG: Structured financial data full injection with user-controlled context; (4) Memory: L2 session history persistence (60-item sliding window); (5) Skill: Predefined skill executor with TTL cache; (6) Multi-Agent: Coordinator + expert Agent Swarm design.
projects.design: 关键工程决策：Claude Code CLI 子进程模式绕过企业内网证书限制；结构化全量注入替代向量 RAG（财务数据实时性强、结构化、体量小 <2K tokens）；场景化引导模板区分"自动注入发送"与"填充模板不发送"解决冷启动问题。技术栈：Vue 3 + TypeScript + Element Plus + Pinia（前端），Node.js + Express + TypeScript（后端），Claude Code CLI（Agent 运行时），飞书多维表格 API（数据源）。
projects.designEn: Key decisions: Claude Code CLI subprocess bypasses enterprise certificate restrictions; Structured full injection over vector RAG (financial data is real-time, structured, small <2K tokens); Scenario-guided templates solve cold start. Tech stack: Vue 3 + TypeScript + Element Plus + Pinia (frontend), Node.js + Express + TypeScript (backend), Claude Code CLI (Agent runtime), Feishu API (data source).

projects.title: 股票行业相似度与反转策略研究
projects.titleEn: Stock Industry Similarity and Reversal Strategy Research
projects.subtitle: 基于年报MD&A文本的算法分类与信息扩散效应
projects.subtitleEn: Algorithmic Classification and Information Diffusion based on Annual MD&A Text
projects.objective: 探索基于MD&A文本相似度的算法行业分类能否更精准捕捉股票间基本面关联，从而改进A股反转策略并识别信息扩散规律。
projects.objectiveEn: Explore whether algorithm-based industry classification using MD&A text similarity can better capture fundamental connections among stocks, improving A-share reversal strategies.
projects.methodology: 研究分为四个部分：(1) Embedding模型比较：对比TF-IDF、BERT、FinBERT、LongBERT、BGE-M3；(2) Louvain社区检测：基于相似度矩阵构建加权图，使用Louvain算法进行无监督行业分类；(3) 行业反转策略回测；(4) Lead-Lag信息扩散分析。
projects.methodologyEn: Research comprises four parts: (1) Embedding model comparison; (2) Louvain community detection for unsupervised industry classification; (3) Industry reversal strategy backtest; (4) Lead-Lag information diffusion analysis.
projects.design: 研究设计采用实证分析框架。使用2012-2024年A股年报MD&A文本。反转策略形成期与持有期网格为{2,4,6,8}周，评估指标包括年化收益、夏普比率、最大回撤。
projects.designEn: Empirical framework using 2012-2024 A-share annual MD&A texts. Reversal strategy formation/holding periods grid: {2,4,6,8} weeks. Metrics: annualized return, Sharpe ratio, max drawdown.

projects.title: 投资者情绪指数与期货价格发现
projects.titleEn: Investor Sentiment Index and Futures Price Discovery
projects.subtitle: 基于股吧文本挖掘的高频情绪指数构建
projects.subtitleEn: Constructing High-Frequency Sentiment Index from Forum Text Mining
projects.objective: 爬取东方财富股吧数据，构建高频投资者情绪指数，检验其对股指期货市场价格发现功能的影响。
projects.objectiveEn: Scrape East Money forum data to construct high-frequency investor sentiment index and test its impact on price discovery of stock index futures.
projects.methodology: 每日爬取股吧帖子；采用中文情感词典进行文本情感分析，构建日度情绪指数；运用函数化数据分析(FDA)进行混频融合；使用VAR模型和脉冲响应函数(IRF)检验情绪对价格发现的动态影响机制。
projects.methodologyEn: Daily scraping of forum posts; apply Chinese sentiment lexicon for textual analysis; use Functional Data Analysis (FDA) for mixed-frequency fusion; employ VAR and Impulse Response Functions.
projects.design: 情绪指数构建流程包括：数据爬取、文本清洗、情感打分、日度聚合。FDA混频方法将日度情绪转化为与期货周度收益率匹配的频率。VAR模型包含期货收益率、情绪指数、成交量等变量。
projects.designEn: Sentiment index construction: data scraping, text cleaning, sentiment scoring, daily aggregation. FDA converts daily sentiment to weekly frequency. VAR model includes futures returns, sentiment, volume.

projects.title: 招商银行数字金融训练营
projects.titleEn: China Merchants Bank Digital Finance Camp
projects.subtitle: 用户行为预测与AI营销智能体
projects.subtitleEn: User Behavior Prediction and AI Marketing Agent
projects.objective: 开发用户广告点击预测、资讯分类模型以及AI营销智能体，提升招商银行数字金融场景的转化率与用户体验。
projects.objectiveEn: Develop user ad click prediction, news classification models, and AI marketing agent to boost conversion rates in CMB digital finance scenarios.
projects.methodology: 采用移动窗口训练规避数据泄露；使用BERT-base-chinese对用户咨询文本进行多分类（8类意图识别）；基于Flask搭建轻量级API服务。
projects.methodologyEn: Applied moving window training; used BERT-base-chinese for multi-class text classification (8 intent categories); built lightweight API service with Flask.
projects.design: 项目采用端到端机器学习工作流。数据预处理包括缺失值处理、文本分词、停用词去除。模型训练采用时间序列交叉验证，移动窗口避免未来信息泄露。API设计遵循RESTful原则。
projects.designEn: End-to-end ML workflow. Data preprocessing: missing value handling, tokenization, stopword removal. Model training used time-series cross-validation with moving window. RESTful API for real-time inference.
